blocks.translation:
• This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very hot or very cold places.
• Dispose of plastic packaging immediately after opening.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts strongly in unnatural directions.
• Some voice lines may have different intonation or may be hard to hear due to the product's characteristics.
• You cannot play with two units at the same time.
• Other infrared remotes, such as from a TV, may cause malfunctions. Direct sunlight near a window or directly under fluorescent lighting may also cause malfunctions. If a malfunction occurs, turn the power off and on again.
• Do not stick stickers or similar items over the receiver or transmitter; it will stop working. If there is an obstacle between the receiver and transmitter, the infrared signal will not be detected and the product will not operate.
• Do not attach the included Robotarou gear to products other than those it is compatible with. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.

△ Caution: To customers who purchased this product — please be sure to read.
● This product is for Ages 15+. Do not give to children below the recommended age. ● This product contains small parts. Take care to prevent small children from accidentally swallowing them. There is a risk of choking. ● This product has pointed or sharp parts. Handle and store with care; there is a risk of unexpected injury. ● Be careful not to pinch fingers, hair, or clothing in rotating parts. ● Do not use near your ears. Incorrect use may cause hearing damage. ● This product contains electronic components; people using pacemakers should take care. ● Do not stare at flashing LED lights for prolonged periods. It may make you feel unwell.
Misuse of batteries may cause overheating, explosion, or leakage. Please observe the following:
● Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries. Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. Install +- (plus/minus) correctly. ● After playing, always turn the power off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous. Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire. ● If battery fluid gets into your eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and consult a physician. If it gets on your skin or clothing, wash with water. When disposing of batteries, follow the waste disposal instructions of your local government.

･･･かもしれないな
では君は一度もウソをついたことがないと...

そのせいで時々人を傷つけてしまうらしい。 どう思う?

blocks.translation:
• All right, let's have fun! Ah — a match, a match!
• I don't hit people.
• Wonderful. Are you doing delivery work?
• Yeah... but what I carry isn't just packages. I deliver happiness.
• That's strange... I have a feeling I'll meet you again.
• I believe human life is more precious than anything. But there is a condition.
• I hate people's excessive desire. It will probably destroy the world.
• ...maybe.
• So you have never told a lie even once...?
• No, I can't lie. No matter what.
• Because of that, it seems you sometimes end up hurting people. What do you think?
• I like you. That you. But there are surely beautiful lies in the world.
• For example, the moon. The moon is a liar. It doesn't actually shine by itself.
• It's a reflection of the sun's light.
• Still, the moon is more trustworthy than the sun. You can stare at it...
• I see... that's a good line.
• Is something wrong? You seem a little down. You said before that there are beautiful lies. But that's hard to do.
• You're fine the way you are. You are my hope.
• If more people were like you, my heart would be at ease.
• By the way, this might be a strange question, but is there someone you want to defeat?
• Yes. There's someone my instincts tell me to fight...
• I have one too.
• If... we managed to beat that person, shall we eat something delicious?
• Something delicious...?
• Yeah... like oden. Summer oden would be nice too.
• What's oden?
• You don't know oden? That's odd. Fine. I'll teach you.
• I'm looking forward to it.

• Whichever of us wins, make sure neither of us leaves lingering feelings for the other.
• Like throwing away the seeds of a fruit after eating it…
• …Ah. No, wait. If you throw away the seeds, they can sprout and fruit again.
• Then… like throwing away a pair of shoes you've worn out…
• Understood.
• The earlier metaphor was better…
